metadata.question: Was the Antarctic ozone hole larger on October 7, 2021 than compared to its area on January 1, 2021?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about the Antarctic ozone hole area comparison between October 7, 2021 and January 1, 2021. This requires: 1. Data Source: I should use ozone data from NASA's OMI or TOMS instruments. The 'MODIS/061/MOD08_D3' collection contains ozone data, or I could use 'TOMS/MERGED' for ozone data. 2. Strategy: - Get ozone data for both dates - Calculate the area where ozone values indicate the ozone hole (typically < 220 Dobson Units) - Compare the areas 3. Important considerations: - The ozone hole is seasonal and typically appears in Antarctic spring (Sept-Nov) - January is Antarctic summer when there is typically no ozone hole - October is peak ozone hole season - Need to define what constitutes the "ozone hole" (usually total ozone column < 220 DU) Let me use the MODIS ozone collection which has good coverage. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Antarctic region const antarctic = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, -90, 180, -60]); // Define dates const octDate = '2021-10-07'; const janDate = '2021-01-01'; // Get ozone data - using MODIS ozone product const octCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD08_D3') .filterDate(octDate, ee.Date(octDate).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(antarctic); const janCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD08_D3') .filterDate(janDate, ee.Date(janDate).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(antarctic); // Check if collections have data const octSize = octCollection.size().getInfo(); const janSize = janCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`October 7, 2021 Images: ${octSize}`); console.log(`January 1, 2021 Images: ${janSize}`); if (octSize === 0 || janSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get first images const octImage = octCollection.first(); const janImage = janCollection.first(); // Define ozone hole as areas with total ozone < 220 Dobson Units const ozoneHoleOct = octImage.select('TotalOzone').lt(220); const ozoneHoleJan = janImage.select('TotalOzone').lt(220); // Calculate areas in square km const areaOct = ozoneHoleOct.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).divide(1e6); const areaJan = ozoneHoleJan.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).divide(1e6); // Reduce regions const octStats = areaOct.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: antarctic, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const janStats = areaJan.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: antarctic, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const octArea = octStats.get('TotalOzone').getInfo(); const janArea = janStats.get('TotalOzone').getInfo(); console.log(`Oct 7 Ozone Hole Area: ${octArea ? octArea.toFixed(0) : 'N/A'} km²`); console.log(`Jan 1 Ozone Hole Area: ${janArea ? janArea.toFixed(0) : 'N/A'} km²`); // Check for valid results if (octArea === null || janArea === null || isNaN(octArea) || isNaN(janArea)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare areas if (octArea > janArea) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
